description: This Java abstract class serves as a base for multi-valued predicate implementations used in MongoDB queries within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages a list of values and provides standard methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: AbstractMultiPredicate
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common implementation for multi-valued predicates, encapsulating a list of values and standard object methods.

methods.name: AbstractMultiPredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a list of values, ensuring it is non-null and immutable.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of values held by the predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on the class type and the contained values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including the class name and values.
